items.html: And behold, it was explained above that the waters that grow the tree are the Hassadim, called water, and they must return and ascend and grow it all, except for what they sweeten of the Gevurot at the time of their ascent, as mentioned in the discourse, and there is no place here for their explanation; only here it is said and explained how they grow ZA himself, in the manner of the waters that enter the root of the tree, and from there the tree sucks — ZA, which is called "the Tree of Life" — and they ascend from below upward to grow it. And understand this.
